faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for the RRC Southern Railway recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Cultural Quota recruitment, specifically for Classical Dance and Mridangam posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the RRC Southern Railway recruitment is 02 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for these posts is between 18 and 30 years, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for general candidates and those not covered under the fee exemption category is Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is the application process online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process for the RRC Southern Railway recruitment is entirely online through the official website www.rrcmas.in.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Classical Dance?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree, Diploma, or Certificate in any Indian Classical Dance from a Government recognized Institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Written Test or Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by a Practical Demonstration and final Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates are provided with an age relaxation of 5 years over the standard maximum age limit of 30 years.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary scale for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be appointed in Level-2 of the VII CPC Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed and downloaded from the official website of the Railway Recruitment Cell, Southern Railway at www.rrcmas.in.
